title: Error 0x80070070 (ERROR_DISK_FULL)
summary: Windows or an installer stopped because the target drive ran out of free space.
meaning: 0x80070070 wraps Win32 error 112, ERROR_DISK_FULL. It appears during updates, upgrades and large installs when the drive being written to has no room left for the files.
commonCauses: The system drive is nearly full
Old update files and temporary files piling up

fixes.title: Check free space
fixes.detail: Open Settings > System > Storage and look at the drive the installer writes to.

fixes.title: Clear temporary files
fixes.detail: In Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files, tick Windows Update Cleanup and Temporary files, then remove them. `cleanmgr` does the same on older builds.

fixes.title: Move large folders off the drive
fixes.detail: Move videos, downloads and old backups to another drive or cloud storage, then try again.
fixes.riskNote: Copy first and check the copy opens before deleting the originals.

prevention: Keep at least 20 GB free on the system drive
